usedFor: Each new Shopify product gets a printable QR code from QRtiger.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Static QR Code” in QRtiger
bestTemplate.why: Each product gets a code for its URL or text, with optional colors, frame and logo.

watchOut: A static code cannot change afterward, so check the link before “Create Static QR Code” runs.
